cards.headline: Flick confirms Raphinha starts against PSG at the Parc des Princes
cards.summary: Hansi Flick said on Monday that Raphinha has recovered and will start in the Champions League match against Paris Saint-Germain on Tuesday night. The Brazilian returned as a substitute at Betis on Saturday after missing the Getafe and Galatasaray games with a hamstring issue picked up on Brazil duty. He has 14 goals and three assists in nine appearances this season.
cards.body: Flick told the press at the Parc des Princes that Raphinha is ready to go and will be in the starting eleven. The forward came off the bench in the 70th minute of the 5-2 win at Betis and equalled Neymar’s total of 186 Barça games. He had been managed carefully after the thigh problem that forced him off during Brazil’s 4-2 win over Australia. SPORT and Fabrizio Romano both reported the confirmation on Monday afternoon. The match kicks off at 21:00 CEST. PSG are the reigning European champions and top of the Champions League table on goal difference. Barça travel without Jules Koundé and Eric García. Raphinha’s return gives Flick another attacking option alongside Lamine Yamal and Anthony Gordon. The German has managed minutes carefully around the returns of key players while dealing with the defensive absences ahead of the Clásico on 25 October.

cards.headline: Àlex Campos called up as Barça travel without Koundé and Eric García
cards.summary: Hansi Flick named 23 players for the trip to Paris, including 18-year-old Barça Atlètic centre-back Àlex Campos. Eric García is out for three to four weeks with a right thigh muscle injury and Jules Koundé misses the match with a left ankle sprain. Andreas Christensen remains unavailable. Gerard Martín is in the squad after being substituted at half-time against Betis.
cards.body: The official list includes Joan García, Szczesny and Livakovic in goal; Cancelo, Balde, Cubarsí, Espart, Martín and Campos in defence; Fariñas, Gavi, Fermín, Pedri, Rodri, Olmo, De Jong and Bernal in midfield; and Jesus, Raphinha, Yamal, Adeyemi, Gordon and Hamza Abdelkarim up front. Campos, born in Aitona in February 2008, is a regular starter for Juliano Belletti’s Barça Atlètic side and has started all seven league games this season. He renewed until 2029 in July. Hamza Abdelkarim, who scored for the B team at the weekend, is also included. Mundo Deportivo and the club site published the squad on Monday. Flick will decide on Martín’s availability on Tuesday. The defensive absences leave Cubarsí as the only fully fit regular centre-back. Cancelo and Espart are expected to cover the full-back positions. The Clásico follows on Sunday at Spotify Camp Nou.

cards.headline: Flick calls PSG the best team of the last two years ahead of Tuesday’s test
cards.summary: Hansi Flick said on Monday that Tuesday’s Champions League match against Paris Saint-Germain is a good test to see where Barcelona stand. He called PSG the best team in the world over the last two seasons and praised Luis Enrique as one of the best coaches. He wants his side to play with confidence and intensity after eleven consecutive wins.
cards.body: Speaking at the Parc des Princes, Flick said the French side have matured as a group and have quality throughout the squad. He highlighted their ability to change games in short periods, citing their recent Ligue 1 win over Strasbourg. He described Luis Enrique as an excellent coach whose team plays with high intensity, presses well and interchanges positions fluidly. Barça arrive with a perfect record across all competitions, nine wins from nine in La Liga and two from two in Europe. Flick said after the game they will know many things about their level. The match is the third in the league phase. Both teams have six points. PSG lead on goal difference. The German has spoken repeatedly about managing the next fixture rather than looking further ahead. The Clásico is five days later. Pedri joined Flick in the press conference. The squad trained at the venue on Monday evening after arriving later than planned because of fog at Charles de Gaulle.

cards.headline: Barça arrive in Paris late after fog delay and complete training at the Parc des Princes
cards.summary: Barcelona landed in Paris on Monday afternoon more than an hour later than scheduled after fog at Charles de Gaulle delayed their flight. The squad then trained at the Parc des Princes from 18:30. Flick and Pedri spoke to the media at 17:45. This was the second travel disruption of the week after weather kept the team overnight in Seville on Saturday.
cards.body: Mundo Deportivo reported the departure from Barcelona was delayed by around 80 minutes. The squad, including Joan Laporta, reached the French capital after 13:30. They stayed at a hotel outside the city before heading to the stadium for the open portion of training. The first 15 minutes of the session were available to media. Flick used the time to prepare for a match in which his side must control PSG’s transitions. The late arrival shortens recovery time after the Betis game and the previous delay. Koundé and Eric García did not travel. The rest of the available group completed the session. The match is scheduled for 21:00 CEST on Tuesday. French authorities confirmed earlier that the fixture will go ahead despite protests in the city. The club has not commented further on the flight beyond the medical updates issued on Sunday.

cards.headline: Flick will decide on Gerard Martín on Tuesday before naming the starting side
cards.summary: Hansi Flick will assess Gerard Martín’s fitness on Tuesday before confirming whether the centre-back starts against Paris Saint-Germain. Martín was substituted at half-time against Betis as a precaution. He is in the travelling squad. With Eric García and Koundé ruled out, Cubarsí is the only fully fit regular centre-back.
cards.body: Mundo Deportivo’s Jordi Cardero reported on Monday that Flick will make the call on Martín after seeing how he responds in the final preparation. The player finished the Betis match with discomfort but tests showed no major issue. If he is not ready to start, Rodri is the emergency option in central defence, a role he has filled earlier in his career. Cancelo and Xavi Espart are available for the full-back positions. Balde has limited minutes this season. The double absence of García and Koundé, plus Christensen’s ongoing thigh problem, has forced Flick to look to the B team for Campos. The German has managed the squad carefully around the returns of Raphinha and De Jong. The Clásico is five days after the Paris fixture, so any further knocks would complicate the Real Madrid match. Cubarsí has started most games and will be central to the back line whatever the decision on Martín.

cards.headline: French prime minister confirms PSG-Barça will go ahead amid protests
cards.summary: French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu said on Monday that the Champions League match between Paris Saint-Germain and Barcelona at the Parc des Princes will not be postponed despite ongoing protests and unrest in the country. Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez confirmed there are no plans to cancel the fixture. The game kicks off at 19:00 GMT on Tuesday.
cards.body: Authorities have deployed extra security for the match after days of protests that affected businesses and public buildings in several cities, including shops belonging to Marseille and Lille. Lecornu told prefects to impose limited and localised curfews where needed. The match is the pick of the league-phase fixtures. Both teams have six points from two games. PSG beat Manchester City 4-2 and Strasbourg 3-1 recently. Barça won 5-1 at Feyenoord and 4-1 at Galatasaray. The French government has insisted the fixture proceeds as planned. Police forces are already stretched by the recent unrest. The club has not commented on the security situation. The squad trained at the stadium on Monday evening. Tickets and broadcast plans remain unchanged. The Clásico follows on Sunday.

cards.headline: Luis Enrique praises Yamal as a special player ahead of the Parc des Princes clash
cards.summary: Luis Enrique called Lamine Yamal a special player and the chosen one in comments published on Monday. The PSG coach said Yamal has a fantastic present and future and is a gift for those who love football. He also noted that Barcelona is more than Yamal, naming Raphinha, Pedri, Cubarsí and Fermín.
cards.body: Enrique spoke to Movistar before the match. He has faced Yamal previously and knows the threat he poses on the right. The 19-year-old scored and assisted in the 5-2 win at Betis and was taken off by Flick to protect him from a booking that could have ruled him out of the Clásico. Yamal has started most games this season and carried a heavy workload. PSG have their own attacking options in Dembélé, Doué and Kvaratskhelia. Enrique’s side are missing Nuno Mendes. The Spanish coach has built a flexible side that presses high and interchanges positions. Flick has spoken of the match as a test of maturity. Both managers will name their sides on Tuesday. The game is live on Movistar in Spain and various platforms elsewhere. Barça’s perfect start faces its sternest test yet against the European champions.

cards.headline: Barça aim to make it twelve wins in a row against the European champions
cards.summary: Barcelona arrive in Paris looking to extend their winning run to twelve matches across all competitions. The side has nine wins from nine in La Liga and two from two in the Champions League. Hansi Flick’s team scored 48 goals and conceded 11 in the eleven games before Tuesday. PSG are top of the league phase on goal difference.
cards.body: The run includes the 5-2 win at Betis, the 4-1 victory at Galatasaray and the 5-1 home win over Feyenoord. Yamal, Raphinha, Gordon, Jesus, Rodri and others have all contributed goals. The defensive absences mean the back line will be reshaped for the first time in the sequence. Cubarsí has been a constant. Cancelo and Espart give Flick options wide. The match at the Parc des Princes is the biggest test of the campaign so far. A win would keep the perfect record intact heading into the Clásico. A defeat would end the sequence and hand the initiative to PSG in the group. Flick has rotated carefully and managed the returns of Raphinha and De Jong. The squad trained at the venue on Monday. Kick-off is 21:00 CEST. The result will shape the narrative heading into Sunday’s meeting with Real Madrid at Spotify Camp Nou.
